About Micro

A personal AI agent

Micro helps you find answers, think things through and get things done. Start a conversation with a question, an idea or a task.

It can search the web, work with your notes and documents, and use tools to carry out a request. Relevant information from your conversations helps it respond with context.

Keep the conversation together

Home is your conversation with Micro. Inbox brings together messages and updates that need your attention. When you delegate work, you can follow its progress and review the result.

Use Micro on the web or install it on your phone. Other ways to reach it, where available, are listed on the Contact page.

Your information, within reach

Services gives you direct access to tools such as notes, documents, files, contacts and events. Use them yourself or ask Micro for help. Agents lets you create assistants for particular purposes.

AI can make mistakes. Check important answers and the outcome of actions. Some requests send relevant information to outside providers; Privacy explains what is stored and shared.

Run it your way

Micro runs on Mu, an open-source personal server. Use this instance or host your own. Each operator chooses the available models, services and pricing.
